maddeler.e:
اصطلقن (form VIII)
# اِصْطَلَقْنَ (iṣṭalaqna) /isˤ.tˤa.laq.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِصْطَلَقَ (iṣṭalaqa)
# اُصْطُلِقْنَ (uṣṭuliqna) /usˤ.tˤu.liq.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِصْطَلَقَ (iṣṭalaqa)
# اِصْطَلِقْنَ (iṣṭaliqna) /isˤ.tˤa.liq.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِصْطَلَقَ (iṣṭalaqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
